attchmntText: Tamil Nadu Newsprint & Papers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Tamil Nadu Newsprint and Papers Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were determined during the Board Meeting held on Friday, 13th November 2026. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express English daily and the Indhu Tamizh Thisai Tamil daily on Saturday, 14th November 2026. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company requested the BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited to take the above in records.

attchmntText: Tamil Nadu Newsprint & Papers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Board Meeting held on 13th November, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Tamil Nadu Newsprint and Papers Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board also placed before shareholders for approval via postal ballot the re-appointment of Tmt M Sathiyavathy, I.A.S., Retd., with DIN 02357307, as Independent Director for a three-year term from 27.11.2026 to 26.11.2029. Additionally, the appointment of Thiru V Arun Roy, I.A.S., with DIN 01726117, as Director is subject to shareholder approval. The cut-off date for voting is 13th November, 2026. Thiru CS R Sridharan has been appointed as the Scrutinizer for the remote e-voting process.
